import subprocess, json
base = {"version":1,"seed":17,"low_count":1,"attempts":1,"spacing_ms":1,"timeout_ms":1,"windows":[]}
body = json.dumps(base)
LIMIT = 1048576
def mk(total):
    pad = total - len(body.encode()) - 2
    assert pad >= 0
    return (' ' * pad).encode()
for total in (LIMIT, LIMIT+1, LIMIT-1):
    data = mk(total)
    # place body in the middle: spaces + body + spaces
    pre = (total - len(body)) // 2
    raw = b' '*pre + body.encode() + b' '*(total - pre - len(body))
    assert len(raw) == total, (len(raw), total)
    open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/mbyte.json','wb').write(raw)
    r = subprocess.run(['python3','submission/ipv6_replay.py','plan','/workspace/tmp/t/work/mbyte.json'],capture_output=True)
    print(total, r.returncode, r.stderr.decode().strip()[:60] or 'ok')
EOF
